title: UAAP: Late 3s by Amiel Acido help UST clip FEU to stop slide

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—University of Santo Tomas snapped a three-game losing streak after escaping Far Eastern University, 86-85, in the UAAP Season 89 men’s basketball tournament on Sunday at Araneta Coliseum. It was a crucial win for the Growling Tigers, who moved within a game behind FEU and La Salle for a place in the Final Four with a 5-6 record. Amiel Acido came up big for UST, hitting 11 of his 23 points in the final 7:45, including back-to-back triples that gave the Tigers an 86-82 buffer with 1:12 remaining.
